description_en: Removes a client ID from an OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider (IdP)
description_zh: 调用RemoveClientIdFromOIDCProvider移除OIDC身份提供商中的指定客户端ID
name: RemoveClientIdFromOIDCProvider

parameters.help_en: The name of the OIDC IdP
parameters.name: oidc_provider_name

parameters.help_en:
The client ID that you want to remove.

The client ID can contain letters, digits, and special characters and cannot start with the special characters. The special characters are `periods, (.), hyphens (-), underscores (_), colons (:), and forward slashes (/)`.\`\`

The client ID can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
指定的客户端ID。

格式：允许英文字母、数字、特殊字符`.-_:/`，不能以特殊字符`.-_:/`开头。

长度：最大128个字符
parameters.name: client_id
